This sorghum plot is small, and with the money I have I would rather not spend on chemical fertilizer this season. I will plant my usual local seed and use some manure if I can, and I will depend on the rains because I do not have irrigation here. Most of the work will be done by my family, and I do not expect to hire labor for this plot.
